reasoning: User-controlled request parameters are concatenated into an HTML response without proper escaping. The blacklist regex is ineffective, allowing malicious tags to bypass detection and be reflected in the response body, which is a XSS sink.

proof_of_concept.description: Inject a tag that bypasses the flawed regex and executes JavaScript when rendered.
proof_of_concept.expected_effect: When the response is rendered in a browser, the onmouseover handler triggers an alert, demonstrating reflected XSS.
